name: poultry-weight-tracker
description: Full-Stack Poultry Flock Bodyweight, Uniformity & Shed-Wise Management System

scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build
scripts.backend:build: cd backend && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build
scripts.frontend:build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run frontend:build && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name=poultry-weight-tracker
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run frontend:build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.android:build: npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew assembleDebug
